# AGENTS.md Context Engineering

This repository explains how to use layered `AGENTS.md` files as project memory for AI coding agents.

## Important Files

- `/README.md`: overview, quick start, and project structure.
- `/AGENTS.md`: root AI-agent instructions for this repository.
- `/docs/analysis.zh-CN.md`: converted Chinese source analysis.
- `/docs/principles.md`: design principles for layered instruction files.
- `/docs/templates/root-AGENTS.md`: root instruction template.
- `/docs/templates/module-AGENTS.md`: module instruction template.
- `/docs/references.md`: public references used to shape repository structure.
- `/examples/go-task-service/AGENTS.md`: Go example guidance.
- `/examples/python-task-service/AGENTS.md`: Python example guidance.
- `/examples/js-task-service/AGENTS.md`: JavaScript example guidance.

## Recommended Reading Order

1. `README.md`
2. `docs/principles.md`
3. One example project under `examples/`
4. `docs/analysis.zh-CN.md` for the full original argument
